rationale: Within a qualified automatic cold or explicitly selected strict-FP64 exact Direct owner, bounded screened proposals inherit existing Standard model, spin, resource and complete final-proof admission without an additional functional whitelist. Zero or unset interval cannot create an unbounded screened chain: the cap is eight deltas. Proposal energies never count toward the mandatory full-density closing pair. Internally retained eligible same-geometry warm states use ordinary full-density proof; explicit seeds, changed geometry and clear restore cold policy. Explicit proposals=0 restores the ordinary screened cadence. Public resource budgets remain unsupported. The first eight eligible delta actions per solve may use 1e-9 screening through an explicit provisional MD-J/generated-K facade; the immutable target cutoff remains in force for full/warm/final/force consumers. Unsupported producers and exhausted proposal budgets retain the original cutoff; coarse_screening=0 disables only this heuristic. The restricted primitive pure-J proposal uses its requested cumulative omission allowance up to 1e-9 on an invocation-local view. The prepared physical view keeps its 1e-12 cap; complete full-density closure, ordinary graph capture and warm replay cannot inherit the temporary allowance. Hybrid exchange, unrestricted and nonprimitive recipes retain their existing caps.
revisit_condition: Broaden provider, spin or proof capabilities only with independent cold/warm/displaced E/F validation. Preserve the qualified automatic/explicit admission, finite screened epoch, fresh full closure and truthful work counters; sampled PBE0 speedups do not establish a universal functional or geometry performance guarantee.
